summary: Verified real-BLE (Beta) addition on Expo web preview. Backend (5 pytest cases including new /api/ai/chat language=en/id) all pass. Frontend: preview boots cleanly with no crash after react-native-ble-plx install; Health tab renders locked cards while disconnected; Device tab shows existing hold-to-connect + Device Information block AND the new 'REAL BLE (BETA)' section with amber warning ('Preview build - Real BLE is disabled') and no ble-scan-btn on web (as expected). Language toggle correctly localizes the new section to 'BLE ASLI (BETA)' and warning 'Build preview - BLE asli dinonaktifkan'. Mocked 2s hold-to-connect still toggles connection state. AI chat sends 'how am i doing' and receives an LLM reply from /api/ai/chat.

react_native_issues.issue: React Native web console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Reference: /app/frontend/app/index.tsx:528 (Toast <View pointerEvents="none">). Non-blocking but should be migrated to style.pointerEvents for RN 0.75+.

action_items: (Minor) Migrate `<View pointerEvents="none">` in the Toast (index.tsx:528) to `style={{ pointerEvents: 'none' }}` to remove the RN-web deprecation warning.
critical_code_review_comments: ble.ts stub correctly gates real BLE behind Platform.OS !== 'web' and Constants.executionEnvironment !== 'storeClient'; require('react-native-ble-plx') is inside a try/catch so preview cannot crash if the native module is absent.
RealBLEPanel branches on ble.supported to render the fallback amber warning without a scan button on web - matches the spec.
i18n keys beta_ble / beta_ble_desc / beta_unsupported / beta_unsupported_hint / scan / scanning / stop_scan / no_devices / perm_denied / unknown_device present in both en + id.
Backend /api/ai/chat accepts optional language: 'en' | 'id' and swaps system_message accordingly; both languages return 200 with a non-empty answer.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_eqoband_api.py (added test_ai_chat_accepts_language_param and detail assertion for blank message)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Web preview correctly renders RealBLEPanel with `ble.supported=false` and hides ble-scan-btn - this is by design. Do NOT flag as a regression. Real BLE requires a native Android/iOS build.
rca_of_issue: N/A - feature addition verified working end-to-end.
